name: CRM Quote Request — Before Insert — Set Requester
CRM Quote Request — Before Validate — Auto Promote Status
script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_status = old_doc.status if old_doc else None

# Auto-promote: Estimation attached the file in Pending or Revision Requested
# state — flip to Quote Received. Covers both first-round upload AND every
# revision-round re-upload. Without the Revision Requested case, round 2 would
# never advance and Script 5's downstream task/notification work wouldn't fire.
#
# MUST run in Before Validate (not Before Save) so the subsequent validate()
# phase evaluates mandatory_depends_on against the NEW status — otherwise
# quote_value / quote_margin would not be enforced and the save would commit
# with NULLs.
if (
    old_doc is not None
    and old_status in ("Pending", "Revision Requested")
    and doc.status == old_status
    and doc.quote_file
):
    doc.status = "Quote Received"

# Positive-value guard: mandatory_depends_on cannot catch Currency/Percent
# default 0.0, so explicitly reject zero/negative quote_value or quote_margin
# whenever the QR is no longer Pending. Idempotent for Quote Received -> Accepted /
# Revision Requested moves because the values are already populated at that point.
if doc.status != "Pending":
    if not doc.quote_value or doc.quote_value <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Value must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Value Required"))
    if not doc.quote_margin or doc.quote_margin <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Margin must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Margin Required"))
